NYPD is using facial recognition software to track down #BlackLivesMatter protestors.

Currently, there is no city law restricting their use of the program.

In June, prominent Black photographers sold prints of their work for $100 as fundraiser for #BLM.

The Whitney Museum, one of the most renowned in New York City, took advantage of the sale for an exhibit.

Whitney's endowment is more than $100,000,000.
